mapper.select: SELECT /*SQL-ID :isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.CafeCurrentStatsMapper."selectcafeCurrentStats" : 위기청소년카페통계현황*/ A.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS VALUENM /*홍보영역*/ , COUNT(1) AS COUNT /*전체건수*/ , CASE WHEN A.ETC_YN = 'Y' THEN COUNT(1) ELSE 0 END AS YCOUNT /*Y건수*/ , CASE WHEN A.ETC_YN = 'N' THEN COUNT(1) ELSE 0 END AS NCOUNT /*N건수*/ , ROUND( COUNT(A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO) * 100 / DECODE((SUM(COUNT(A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO)) OVER()),0,1,(SUM(COUNT(A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO)) OVER())),2 ) AS PERCENT /*점유율*/ FROM ( SELECT C.CMMNS_CD_VALUE , C.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM , A.ETC_YN , A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , COUNT(*) OVER() CCNT FROM SAC100 C /*공통코드*/ LEFT OUTER JOIN AYE100 A /*사이버상담게시글*/ ON C.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.CRISIS_CAFE_CYBER_OUTRC_SE_CD AND A.FRST_REG_DT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') + 0.99999 AND A.ETC_YN IS NOT NULL AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE C.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'CRISIS_CAFE_CYBER_OUTRC_SE_CD' /*위기카페사이버아웃리치구분*/ AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' ) A GROUP BY A.CMMNS_CD_VALUE , A.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM , A.ETC_YN ORDER BY A.CMMNS_CD_VALUE

SELECT /*SQL-ID :isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.CafeCurrentStatsMapper."selectcafeCurrentStats" : 위기청소년카페통계현황*/ C.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS VALUENM /*홍보영역*/ , COUNT(1) AS COUNT /*전체건수*/ , CASE WHEN A.ETC_YN = 'Y' THEN COUNT(1) ELSE 0 END AS YCOUNT /*Y건수*/ , CASE WHEN A.ETC_YN = 'N' THEN COUNT(1) ELSE 0 END AS NCOUNT /*N건수*/ , ROUND( COUNT(A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO) * 100 / DECODE((SUM(COUNT(A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO)) OVER()),0,1,(SUM(COUNT(A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO)) OVER())),2 ) AS PERCENT /*점유율*/ FROM SAC100 C /*공통코드*/ LEFT OUTER JOIN AYE100 A /*사이버상담게시글*/ ON C.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.CRISIS_CAFE_CYBER_OUTRC_SE_CD AND A.FRST_REG_DT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') + 0.99999 AND A.ETC_YN IS NOT NULL WHERE C.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'CRISIS_CAFE_CYBER_OUTRC_SE_CD' /*위기카페사이버아웃리치구분*/ AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY C.CMMNS_CD_VALUE , C.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM , A.ETC_YN ORDER BY C.CMMNS_CD_VALUE
